description: Another single serving cookie recipe straight out of the oven - this time a Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookie!   1 peanut butter oatmeal Chip Cookie: 2 tablespoons melted butter 2 tablespoon packed dark brown sugar 1 heaping tablespoon of peanut butter  1 large egg yolk only  1/8 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or extract  1/4 cup AP flour 1 1/2 tablespoons oats  1/8 teaspoon baking soda 1/8 teaspoon fine table salt 2 tablespoons semi sweet chocolate chips  Steps:  Preheat the oven to 375F convection or 400F regular bake setting. In a small bowl stir together all the ingredients except for the chocolate chips and oats just until combined into a dough. Fold in the chocolate chips and oats and then form the dough into a ball.  Chill the dough for 10 mins in the freezer just to set it.  Place the cookie on a parchment lined tray and Bake 11-12 minutes or until golden on the edges but still gooey inside. if it puffs too much you can lightly press it down right when it comes out with a spatula. Cool a few minutes then enjoy!!
transcript: I own a bakery that makes 12,000 baked goods a day so I've been challenging myself to make single-serve cookie recipes because sometimes you just need one perfect cookie to take the edge off. This time I give you one single peanut butter oatmeal chip cookie because peanut butter and chocolate is the most superior combo to ever be created on this planet. Period. This is a real thickie with a chewy texture from brown sugar and oats and it was actually so substantial. I even shared it with my husband.
